consequence.statement: New optional metrics are available for monitoring certificate lifecycles; existing deployments are unaffected.

original.statement: Two new Prometheus metrics for certificate issuance and expiration times are now available: certmanager_certificate_not_before_timestamp_seconds and certmanager_certificate_not_after_timestamp_seconds.

decision.reason: [ev-e8facc7cba98] is a Feature entry that only adds two new metrics, certmanager_certificate_not_before_timestamp_seconds and certmanager_certificate_not_after_timestamp_seconds. It says nothing fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated, and no default changes. That makes "none" (informational) the right consequence for a purely additive change. The proposed statement fits this, but the note doesn't actually call the metrics "optional" or say existing deployments are unaffected; both are inferred from the change only adding things.
